sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Special Offer is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Got another job for you, brother! I see the demand for backpacks, can't lose profit now. I've only got basic backpacks, so I need to bring in some exclusive items. That'll bring in more customers. You know what I mean, right? If you get some really rare rigs and backpacks, I'll be in your debt!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find Sanitar's bag in raid
- Hand over the equipment
- Find Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Tagilla Edition) in raid
- Hand over the equipment
- Find LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (Goons Edition) in raid
- Hand over the equipment
- Find Mystery Ranch NICE COMM 3 BVS frame system (Coyote) in raid
- Hand over the equipment
- Find Crye Precision CPC plate carrier (Goons Edition) in raid
- Hand over the equipment

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +85,500 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 328,000 Roubles
  - 344,400 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 377,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset
- 2× Diamond Age Bastion helmet (Black)
"You know what? These thingies are so good I'm gonna measure them and produce them myself. They're gonna sell out instantly!"
